title: Tight Quantum Speed Limit for Ergotropy Charging in the N-Qubit Dicke Battery
summary: We derive a quantum speed limit for ergotropy charging in the $N$-qubit Dicke battery. With the qubits initially in their ground state and the charger in a coherent state of mean photon number $\bar{n}$, the charging time to a target fraction $\varepsilon$ of the maximum extractable work obeys, in the classical-field limit, $Γ_N τ^{*}(\varepsilon) \geq \arcsin\sqrt{\varepsilon}$, where $Γ_N = 2λ\sqrt{\bar{n}/N}$ is a single rate combining the light-matter coupling, the charger amplitude and the system size.
